text:
Priya (Product): quick pulse check — we need a short, prioritized beta burn-in checklist for GA decision. focus: SLA burn-in, docs freeze, support handoff, monitoring alerts, and pricing validation. who owns the checklist items?

Liam (Eng): I can own SLA burn-in + canary validation. plan: 48h steady-state run with live traffic mirror, then a 24h cost/latency sweep. will need a tickets list for infra requests.

Evelyn (Docs): Docs freeze note — i need final API samples + error matrix by EOD Wed. after that, only critical errata. also need a short "what changes in GA" summary for customers.

Marco (SRE): For monitoring: set these temporary alerts during burn-in:
- P99 latency > 450ms sustained 5m
- error-rate > 0.5% over 10m
- queue-depth > 100 for >5m
We should add a rollbar-like runbook link. tagging @release-bot for smoke runs.

Sam (Sales): Pricing validation: we need a simple commercial checklist — confirm numeric cost per 1M tokens at current config, and one fallback pricing for Dedicated customers. sales wants a one-pager for pilot accounts.

Priya (Product): thanks. proposal: single ticket with subitems owners and ACs. ACs = pass/fail criteria. quick sketch:
- SLA burn-in owner: Liam; AC: 48h mirrored traffic without p99 regressions and no more than 0.5% errors.
- Docs freeze owner: Evelyn; AC: API samples + migration notes live and linked in console.
- Support handoff owner: Marco + support lead; AC: runbook + escalation playbook tested once with oncall.
- Monitoring owner: Marco; AC: alerts + dashboards created, alert noise < 3 false positives in 24h.
- Pricing owner: Sam; AC: published list price + pilot discount rules + billing test with one pilot.

Liam (Eng): tagging infra requests here: "reserve extra pool for burn-in" and "enable request tracing" — both need ticket IDs.

Marco (SRE): created ticket INF-4021 for extra pool. tracing toggle is on config-service, but I'll need a canary flag.

Evelyn (Docs): i'll draft the GA change summary and post a PR: docs#834. will add a short migration snippet for customers migrating from pilot to GA.

Sam (Sales): i'll prepare a short pricing one-pager and send to pilot customers for feedback. want to validate at least 3 pilot accounts by Friday.

Priya (Product): next steps: everyone add their ACs to the ticket PRD-1198 and mark blockers. i'll host a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm owners. if any critical risk (infra, security, or billing) appears, flag it here with :rotating_light:.

release-bot: smoke deployment scheduled for 2025-10-04 22:00 UTC. live mirror enabled for burn-in.

Liam (Eng): ack. I'll post the burn-in plan + traffic generator config in the ticket.

Marco (SRE): will run an oncall drill during the burn-in window to validate playbooks.

Evelyn (Docs): PR opened: docs#834 -> https://git.internal/docs/pulls/834 :thumbsup:

Sam (Sales): pinging pilot list with the one-pager draft now.

Priya (Product): great — I'll close out owners and convert this into the single GA-readiness checklist. thanks all. :tada:
